note: Facts used in the refreshed 7-day Instagram carousel series. Official sources were checked on 2026-11-10; volatile details must be rechecked before travel. Posts remain gated by the repository approval status and INSTAGRAM_LIVE setting.

facts: Airport Limousine 1 toward Haeundae/Gijang has separate Jangsan and Gijang timetables
Busan City lists different first/last airport departures for the Jangsan and Gijang services
Airport light rail connects at Sasang to Metro Line 2 and at Daejeo to Line 3
Jagalchi is a major seafood market in Busan
Seafood purchase and preparation/table-setting charges may be separate depending on the shop
Visitors should confirm species, unit/weight, seafood total and extra charges before preparation
Busan transfer discount applies when transferring between eligible modes within 30 minutes
Up to two transfers are allowed within one trip under the published transfer rule
First and last metro train times vary by station; riders should check station timetables
Weekly tickets open every Tuesday at 07:00 Korea Standard Time for one week four weeks ahead
A small number of same-day on-site tickets may be available first-come, first-served and may sell out early
Sky Capsule operates one way between Mipo and Cheongsapo over about 2 km, taking around 30 minutes
The reservation time is an entry window; the capsule boards sequentially and can be delayed
d04-skycapsule.recheck: Before booking and on travel day

facts: The guide groups the city by day and area rather than attempting to cover every attraction
Travel time and breaks should be included in a realistic itinerary
The guide compares accommodation areas by travel style and access to planned attractions
Visitors should compare routes from the actual accommodation to their priority stops
Busan eomuk is a regional food tradition with different shapes and preparations rather than one single recipe
Street stalls and shops may serve fish cakes with broth; check each shop's menu and price
